summary.name: DishGen
summary.one_liner: DishGen is an AI kitchen assistant that generates custom recipes and weekly meal plans from ingredients, dietary needs, or chat requests.
use_cases: Turn leftover ingredients into a meal
Planning a full week of meals
Getting recipes for weight loss or muscle gain
Requesting dietary substitutions or new cuisines
Adding a recipe generator widget to a website
summary.what_it_does: DishGen generates new recipes and meal plans on demand from text input such as ingredients, dietary needs, or a recipe idea, via chat. Its meal planner builds a full week of meals tailored to preferences and schedule, and can generate recipes for each meal in the plan. A personalized AI profile stores tastes, dietary needs, and goals to tailor suggestions. Users can save, edit, swap, and share recipes. The page also mentions a 1M+ library of AI-generated recipes and an embeddable recipe generator widget.
notable: Personalized AI profile that adapts suggestions to tastes, diet, and goals
Weekly meal planner with per-meal AI recipe generation
Embeddable recipe generator widget for websites
Free Basic tier with 15 usage credits per week
caveats: Paid Premium and Pro/Business tiers are required for personalized AI model, AI nutrition facts beyond limited labels, and more credits
Basic free tier is limited to 15 usage credits per week, where 1 credit equals one recipe or meal plan
Paid plans start with a 7-day free trial and are cancellable anytime
